meta.title: 6 tiny wins that build unstoppable momentum

plates.query: Joseph Wright of Derby small flame lighting a room painting
J. M. W. Turner small stream growing into river painting
Caspar David Friedrich figure part way up a slope painting

beats.text: Six tiny wins that quietly snowball into unstoppable momentum.
One. Make your bed. The day's first completed task tells your brain you're someone who finishes.
Two. Tidy one surface. Outer order has a strange way of creating inner calm.
Three. Finish one thing you've been avoiding. The relief alone will power the next hour.
Four. Move your body for five minutes. Energy isn't found — it's generated.
Five. Send the message you've been putting off. Closing a loop frees up more mind than you'd think.
Six. Write down tomorrow's single priority tonight. You'll wake up already aimed.
Momentum isn't a mood you wait for. It's a snowball you start — one tiny win at a time.
